summary: Design supportable IT services with clear requirements, service levels and continuity records. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: IT service design training helps service designers, managers and operations leads turn requirements into workable service specifications and handoffs. Participants learn to analyze requirements, map workflows and dependencies, define service-level targets, assess capacity and availability assumptions, and document continuity and security needs. Exercises produce process maps, a service-level matrix and a readiness checklist for service transition and operational review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, review or operate IT services and need to turn service requirements into clear design records and operational handoffs.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of IT service management terminology and experience contributing to a service or operational process are expected. No coding is required. Advanced architecture and security topics receive conceptual and operational treatment, not technical implementation training.
